en: A black‑and‑white postcard view over a lakeside town with a railway station and rail yard in the foreground. Several tracks curve past low station buildings and freight cars, with larger residential houses and trees in front. In the distance is a wide body of water and a low shoreline. Printed text at the top reads the town name and identifies the railway station and yard in Swedish.
